plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-jira
plugins.description: Jira Cloud: webhook trigger for issues, comment and transition nodes, issue lookup tool

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-confluence
plugins.description: Confluence Cloud: space pages as a knowledge source, CQL search tool, create/update page output node

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-jenkins
plugins.description: Jenkins: run a job as a verification step, start a task from a failed build, read console logs

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-sonarqube
plugins.description: SonarQube (self-hosted): quality gate and open issues as workflow steps and agent tools

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-office365
plugins.description: Microsoft 365 over Graph: send mail, read calendar, search OneDrive/SharePoint files, post into Teams (device-code sign-in)

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-smtp
plugins.description: Email through any SMTP relay: a step, an agent tool and a notification channel, with presets for Gmail, Microsoft 365, Outlook, Seznam and iCloud

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-playwright
plugins.description: Playwright: run e2e tests headless as a workflow step, shard across parallel map items, agent-readable failure report, browser install step

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-loki
plugins.description: Grafana Loki: ships every task event plus host and process metrics to a self-hosted Loki, with ready-made Overview, Task explorer and Host dashboards

plugins.name: ilmari-plugin-jev
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev via OpenRouter: the jev step, a quick decision that picks one of your options from a piece of text without running an agent
